source_commit_note: Git tag v1.6.3 and npm gitHead agree. Installed Windows artifact still has no public ui subcommand.
dist_shasum_note: the main npm package is a thin installer: dist/ ships only .d.ts types, the compiled app lives in per-platform optionalDependencies
platform_dist_shasums_note: public npm registry metadata; acquisition uses pinned npm exec and npm integrity checks
acquisition: compatible local compiled library/runtime first; otherwise npm exec --package=@colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.3, offline verification and library probe; CODEGRAPH_NO_DOWNLOAD=1 disables the shim's GitHub binary fallback
engines_note: the library needs node:sqlite (Node 22.5+). Both serve and initialize use the same verified runtime: bundled Node for platform packages, system Node for a compiled source checkout. Wrapper/setup require Node >=20.

bundle_layout.posix_note: bin/codegraph is a POSIX shell wrapper that execs the same command; the wrapper never uses it (it would re-inject CODEGRAPH_HOST_PPID)

env_forced.CODEGRAPH_DIR: <single directory name under repo root, chosen by wrapper>

index_dir_naming.constraint: CODEGRAPH_DIR accepts a single directory name under the project root only
